title: Data-driven tests
summary: Generate one test per invalid email from a data array, so each case is reported (and can fail) on its own.
why: Equivalence classes and boundary values from manual test design map directly onto data arrays. One test per row gives one report line per case instead of a single test that stops at the first bad value.
objectives: const invalidEmails = [...] with at least 4 values
Each test asserts 'Enter a valid email address'
hints: Titles must be unique — include the value in the title.
pitfalls: A loop inside one test: the first failure hides the rest.
Duplicate titles — Playwright refuses to run them.
teachAlong: Cause: the loop creates N tests at collection time.
Gate: at least 4 tests must run, and switching validation off must fail them.

requires.reason: Generate the tests from the data array (for … of / forEach) instead of copy-pasting test bodies.

mutants.reason: the form accepts invalid email addresses

wrongSolutions.label: one hard-coded case
